Sana — thanks for the clear recap and the scope file. Short reply with a proposed path and owners; I put more detail in the attached checklist (redwood_trial_checklist.pdf).

Recommended trial paths (tradeoffs):
1) Hosted (fastest onboard): Redwood hosted API — minimal infra, fastest time-to-first-test, per-token billing. Good for early accuracy/latency signals.
2) Dedicated sandbox (recommended for NovusCare mid-PoC): Reserved GPU pool (shared only with NovusCare) — predictable throughput, lower unit cost for steady load, supports KV cache tuning. Requires a short capacity reservation (we can do a 1-month commitment).
3) Private VPC (strictest controls): Customer-managed VPC or on-prem — full isolation and KMS integration, takes longest to provision (2–4 weeks), best for regulated workloads.

Our recommended plan: start hosted for week 0–1 (smoke + accuracy checks), then shift to a short dedicated sandbox window for load/latency tests during weeks 2–3, and evaluate VPC only if you want long-term isolation. This hybrid minimizes setup time while letting you validate scale.

Proposed success criteria (suggested — please edit):
- Latency: generation p95 <= 450ms for 512-token requests under target concurrency (TBD).
- Throughput: sustain 40 reqs/sec across the sandbox pool without queueing.
- Quality: top-1 accuracy >= 78% on annotated triage set (we'll handshake on labels).
- Cost: per-1k-token price <= $X (we'll propose numbers once we know config).

Action owners & timeline (short):
- Kickoff meeting: Aditya to schedule (target Tue 2/17 morning PST).
- Infra setup: Laura Bennett (trial infra lead) — provision sandbox/dedicated capacity, SOC2 evidence, KMS options. ETA: 3 business days after kickoff for hosted smoke; 7–10 days for dedicated sandbox.
- Eval harness + prompts: Marissa Cole (solutions) — provide eval harness, sample prompts, metrics dashboard. ETA: deliver harness Day 2 post-kickoff.
- Procurement / SOW: Aditya to loop procurement contact and send template.

I've added a HubSpot link for the deal and a draft trial checklist in Drive.
